review_scope: Three two-page orders text-read; first page of each visually checked for identity/date/operative instructions. Criminal/specialty extension detail not substantively analyzed; no deadline calculations.
limitations: Court may approve or deny remote argument; date/time may change after format change.
Excluded expedited/emergency and specialty proceedings are not treated as eligible for agreed-extension procedure.
Earlier eDCA orders expressly withdrawn by AO23-1 are retained only as historical references.
